description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeMembershipService in the HRM system. It tests the service's methods such as retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching of employee membership records.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeMembershipService's functionalities related to managing employee memberships in the HR system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeMembershipService instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee membership record by its ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests saving (creating or updating) an employee membership record.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple employee memberships for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests searching for employee memberships with specific filters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of employee memberships matching certain search criteria.
